name: Strawberry Cough
summary: **Strawberry Cough** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] believed to be a cross of [[haze|Haze]] and [[strawberry-fields|Strawberry Fields]], though its exact breeding origin is not documented. Grower Kyle Kushman obtained a clone-only cutting from another grower in Bridgeport, Connecticut, in 1999 and is credited with popularizing it. [[breeder:Dutch Passion]] and other seed banks now sell seed versions.

born.display: unknown; in circulation by 1999 via clone
